permit.quote: You may opt out of having your data sold or shared by us, which includes having it used for targeted advertising or for third parties to use for direct marketing or similar uses

prohibit.quote: We don’t do that without your permission.

conflicts.situation: A California customer who has not opted out has personal data sold or shared with third parties for those third parties' direct marketing.
conflicts.reason: The opt-out framing implies such disclosure occurs by default, while the Shine the Light statement says it requires permission. The policy does not say whether not opting out counts as permission.

permit.quote: Some of these third parties may be able to associate the data collected through these technologies with other information they already have about you (ex. your interests, actions and connections) to provide ads or offers personalized for you.

prohibit.quote: Progressive does not share with nonaffiliates so they can market to you

conflicts.situation: An insured customer uses the App, and third-party SDKs collect advertising identifiers that the third parties use to show that customer personalized ads or offers.
conflicts.reason: The GLBA notice says no sharing with nonaffiliates for their marketing, yet the App lets third parties collect identifiers for personalized offers. The policy does not say whether SDK collection counts as sharing.

permit.quote: We may collect and use the preceding Personal Information (including Sensitive Personal Information) about you and your household for the following purposes

prohibit.quote: described in the "Notice at Collection" below for purposes other than those specified by the CCPA and its regulations.

conflicts.situation: Sensitive geolocation or health information collected from a California consumer is used for marketing products offered by others or for lead monetization, which are listed Purposes.
conflicts.reason: The Notice at Collection lists marketing and lead monetization among purposes for all Personal Information, including sensitive data, while the Supplement limits sensitive data to CCPA-specified purposes. The policy does not say which purposes apply to sensitive data.
